insight: Ships as a first-class voice provider in the Vercel AI SDK, Pipecat, LiveKit, and Vapi voice-agent stacks.
name: LMNT
tagline: Streaming text-to-speech with voice cloning for real-time apps.
description: LMNT is an AI text-to-speech platform that turns text into natural speech with ultra-low latency, built for conversational agents, games, and real-time apps. It supports instant voice cloning from a short sample and multilingual synthesis, and is exposed as a developer API plus a web playground. It is offered as a built-in voice provider across major voice-agent frameworks.

modelSupport.notes: Ships its own streaming text-to-speech and voice-cloning models.

edge: Built for real-time agents — ~150–200ms streaming latency and voice cloning from a 5-second sample, priced below premium TTS rivals.
pros: Instant voice cloning from a sample
Free tier plus affordable paid plans
cons: Quality trails top expressive TTS models
